story.idea: Our idea grew from the wish to bring together creativity, modern technology and the chance to create unique spaces.
story.how: With advanced technology we print photos, artistic motifs, logos and personalised designs directly onto a range of wall surfaces.

story.care: We pay particular attention to quality, precision and a personal approach to every client.
story.where: We work in Ticino and across Switzerland, and we also carry out projects elsewhere in Europe.
story.canvas: We don't just print pictures. We create spaces that tell stories.

Faq.title: Frequently asked questions
Faq.lead: Answers to the questions we hear most about direct wall printing.
Faq.moreText: Write to us, call us or send a WhatsApp message: we're happy to help.

what.a: A vertical printer prints your image straight onto the wall: photos, artistic motifs, logos or personalised designs. No wallpaper, film or stickers.

surfaces.q: Which surfaces can you print on?
surfaces.a: Plaster, gypsum, concrete, wood, glass and metal. Before every job we check that the surface is suitable.

size.q: How large can a print be?
size.a: Up to about {height} high; the width is practically unlimited.

outdoor.q: Can you print on exterior walls?
outdoor.a: Yes. We print indoors and outdoors, with the right surface preparation.

durability.q: How long does a wall print last?
durability.a: The certified inks we use keep colours bright and details sharp for more than {years} years, outdoors too.

preparation.q: Does the wall need to be prepared?
preparation.a: Sometimes. Before printing we look at the surface with you and, if needed, prepare it properly.

ownImage.q: Can I use my own photo or design?
ownImage.a: Of course. Send us your photo or design, and we prepare and adapt the artwork for a high-quality result. In the 3D configurator you can try it on your wall straight away.

duration.q: How long does a project take?
duration.a: It depends on the size, the design and the surface. We give you the timing together with the quote.

price.q: How much does a wall print cost?
price.a: The price depends on the area, the design and the surface. The 3D configurator shows an indicative price at once; the quote is free.

quote.q: How can I request a quote?
quote.a: Through the contact form, by phone, on WhatsApp or by e-mail. From the 3D configurator you can send us the request with the measurements and a preview of your wall.

Privacy.title: Privacy policy
Privacy.lead: How we handle your data when you visit the website or contact us.

controller.title: Who is responsible
controller.text: {company} is responsible for the processing of your data. For any question about data protection, write to us at {email}.

data.title: What data we process
data.text: When you use the form, we process your name, email address, phone number (if you give it) and your message. When you write to us or call us directly, we process the data of the message or the call. When you visit the website, the server records technical data such as the IP address, date and time, the page visited and the browser type.

purpose.title: Why we process it
purpose.text: We use the data from the form and from contacts only to answer your request and to prepare a quote. We use the technical data to run the website safely, for example to block automated messages (spam).

recipients.title: Who we share it with
recipients.text: The website is hosted by {hosting}. Form messages reach us by email through {mailProvider}. These providers process the data only on our behalf. We do not sell your data and do not use it for advertising.

abroad.title: Data abroad
abroad.text: If a provider processes data outside Switzerland, it does so only in countries with adequate protection or with contractual safeguards, as the law requires.

cookies.title: Cookies and statistics
cookies.text: The website uses no tracking cookies and no statistics or advertising tools. The fonts load from our own server, with no requests to Google.

links.title: Links to other services
links.text: The website contains links to WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook and Google Maps. Only when you open them do these services receive data from you; their own privacy policies apply.

retention.title: How long
retention.text: We keep messages as long as we need them for your request and for legal duties, for example the accounts of a job. The technical server data is deleted after a short time.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.text: Under the Swiss Federal Act on Data Protection (FADP) you can ask what data we hold about you, have it corrected or deleted, and object to its processing. If the GDPR applies to you, you also have the right to data portability. Write to us at {email}. You can also contact the Federal Data Protection and Information Commissioner (FDPIC).

changes.title: Changes
changes.text: We may update this policy when the website changes. The version published here applies.
